plan.title: Live RFQ counter offer remains pending

steps.note: Open the prepared live RFQ Responses screen with the vendor's normal bid.
Send a buyer counter offer of 90 against the vendor's own live bid.
Verify the buyer-side grid marks the counter offer as initiated.
Move to the invited vendor's separate supplier-portal session while keeping the buyer session available.
Open the event overview where the vendor's pending counter offer is shown.
Verify the vendor can see the pending counter offer.
Verify the counter offer remains pending and has not been answered.
Attempt a vendor revision while the counter offer is pending and require Procol to refuse it.
Open the buyer's Master QCS to inspect the current comparison after the unanswered counter offer.
Verify the vendor column is present with a real vendor name.
Verify the visible Master QCS arithmetic remains internally consistent with the current prices.
